node.title: Re^4: Error Handling in Selenium
node.author: 9mohit2
node.doctext: Hi Hauke, Sorry for the "not working" thing. The problem I am facing is find_element throws error which are captured by the Webdriver prompt but it does not throws error to the command prompt and execution goes till the end of script. So I wanted a way so that the script stops execution if any element is not found. Can you please suggest any way of doing so as I have seen posts were eval is being used in this sense only but it did not work on mine.
